text:
The data point to mid-2021. Unemployment is 5.4%, core CPI is 4.23% year over year, the fed funds rate is 0.08%, and the 10-year yield is 1.29%. The 10-year yield fell by 0.29 over three months, consistent with a peak in March 2021 near 1.7% and a drop to about 1.3% by July.

Core CPI at 4.23% matches June 2021 (4.5%) or July 2021 (4.3%). Headline CPI at 5.28% looks like July 2021 (5.4%), with June at 5.4% as well. Unemployment of 5.4% matches June or July 2021 (5.9% in June, 5.4% in July). That makes July 2021 the best fit, and the 10-year yield of about 1.24–1.3% at the end of July supports it. Payrolls averaged 831k over three months, which fits May–July 2021.

The 12-month equity return of 31% fits July 2021.
